The person on the right holds a bassoon diagonally across their body, showing the long tube, metal keys, and flared bell at the top. The person on the left holds a similar instrument, though partially obscured. The background appears to be an indoor setting with some furniture or equipment visible.

artifact_observations.location: Key mechanisms on the right bassoon
artifact_observations.reasoning: The keys lack sharp edges and distinct rods/springs. They appear slightly melted or fused with the wooden body, lacking the crisp metallic reflection expected of real instrument hardware.

artifact_observations.location: Hands of the subject on the right

artifact_observations.location: Face of the subject on the right

To audit the boundary between the metal keys and the wooden body, checking for the 'melting' artifact observed in the key mechanisms.
To determine if the bocal is physically present but occluded, or if it is geometrically missing/collapsed into the main tube.
